prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: COMPLETE playable FRELJORD town composition study for ORIGINAL Heroes of Might and Magic III, native800x374, wide800:374 banner. This full scene is an authoring blueprint, NOT the unbuilt terrain game layer.
Input1 actual native HoMM3 Tower town background: authority ONLY for compact painted1999 scenery texture, low frontal slightly elevated camera and atmospheric depth. Input2 actual native Stronghold background: authority ONLY for warm earth/wood/rock material values, not its building grid. Input3 official LoR Poro Herder: Freljord ordinary community, rustic materials and region subject inspiration ONLY, not splash-art style or copied pixels. Input4 official Draklorn Inquisitor: restrained angular Frostguard material motif ONLY; no figures from any input.
Paint ONE coherent inhabited northern fjord hamlet with shared ground and perspective, not isolated catalogue buildings. Broad sheltered sloping earth and basalt with patchy settled snow. Dark weathered timber, carved northern knots, rough charcoal stone, shingles/sod/hide roofs, bone-and-iron fittings, small warm hearth windows. Upper-left diffuse daylight, earth ochre and dark brown against grey-white snow and desaturated blue distance. Real native1999 richly textured painted miniature scenery; restrained highlights and clear tiny silhouettes. One low frontal camera, visible front walls with only a little roof and right wall, NO rigid isometric board, 3D production look, glossy plastic, anime, vector kits, toy diorama, huge blue ice palaces or Demacian architecture. Small project northern knot motifs only, NO invented united Freljord royal crest. Ornn/Anivia/Frostguard motifs belong only to their own institutions.
Compose the ENTIRE800x374 scene before splitting. Distant mountains and cloudy pale sky occupy approximately y0..90 behind the town. Rugged cliff ridge is only the far-left backdrop; broad navigable land fills nearly all the foreground and centre. A narrow sheltered fjord inlet occupies ONLY the outer-right middle edge x704..799,y169..242: no water under any ordinary buildings. Shore curls behind the smithy, whose whole base at y295..304 is dry land. Real landward dock approach enters at x692..704,y195..205, with only pier/boat projecting rightward over water. No other pool, frozen lake or stream.
Place these17 DISTINCT sites within these native image coordinate zones, with completely visible architecture, connected footpaths, clear intervening space and varied footprints. Coordinates are NOT labels to draw. Preserve ground scale: rear doors visibly smaller than near doors despite physically monumental rear buildings. Monumental rear institutions should be larger in overall mass than modest near services. No regular rows, identical roof sizes, solid building intersections or freestanding rectangular display plinths.
1 far-left Harbinger cliff EYRIE x8..118,y60..146: broad natural basalt landing ledge nested into ridge with sheltered stone perches, restrained ice spines. NO Yeti cave, palace, bird statue or embodied bird.
2 dominant back civic council HALL x240..414,y42..168: substantial many-bay timber communal hall, high layered shingle roof, broad stone footings, stepped ridge and open low approach; warm welcome, not a king's palace.
3 old-god THUNDER STONE CIRCLE x132..224,y118..188: low weathered bear-carved posts, small vow shelter and practical enclosure, not church or embodied god.
4 broad rear WINTER FORTRESS x584..789,y50..163: substantial receding dark timber keep and palisade gate with two weatherproof watch platforms/stone footings. Strong skyline, no whiteCastle battlements.
5 tall rear LOREKEEPER GUILD x435..560,y88..205: four terraced timber archive roof tiers and attached study bays; monumental physical archive with small distant doors, not icy wizard tower.
6 mid-left TROLL DEN x8..127,y180..261: low rough rock shelter and heavy timber supports, broad credible entrance, snow at edges.
7 ANIVIA MEMORIAL SHRINE x142..222,y207..272: modest weathered bird-carved stone memorial and quiet shelter, restrained frost, no deity.
8 SEER DIVINER LODGE x243..359,y196..281: timber/bone winter shelter with owl-carved lintel, layered cloth veils and small open roof stargazing gallery. NO telescope or huge actual owl.
9 DRAKLORN FROSTGUARD SANCTUM x383..510,y219..285: low angular purple-black cold stone, fur wind curtains, violet-dark cloth, bifurcated lintel and a restrained enclosed ritual wing. Distinct institution, not bear huts or glowing ice palace.
10 CRYSTAL QUARRY YARD x583..690,y182..246: small managed basalt quarry, timber winch, covered crystal bins, no luminous crystal palace.
11 OPTIONAL DOCK x692..794,y174..225: narrow timber land approach to a real shoreline pier and one small moored northern longboat. Entire dock plus vessel visible.
12 foreground-left PORO HERDING YARD x10..119,y291..370: modest low timber shelter, rounded low doors, woven windbreak, hay baskets and snug yard. No huge poro character or birds.
13 communal TAVERN/WARMOTHER LONGHOUSE x135..276,y286..370: modest inviting low longhouse with practical food-smoking lean-to and a small upper meeting chamber. NOT a giant front palace, grounded bigger human-scale doorway than rear hall.
14 FOREGROUND MARKET x295..407,y302..365: modest low food/hide stalls and stores, one ochre/red awning, real earth between stalls, not giant bazaar.
15 DRUVASK HERDER PENS x428..570,y294..371: low stout stockade yard, roofed winter stalls and riding-equipment rack, no huge animal or knight castle.
16 small FOREGROUND SMITHY/FORGE x695..794,y242..304: modest working smithhouse with basalt hearth, short twin flues and small ram-carved lintel only here, restrained orange embers. All foundation dry. No towering cathedral furnace.
17 HUNTERS' LODGE x605..769,y309..371: low long timber equipment lodge with bow racks, covered skin-drying porch and practical stores; clear entrance on shared path, no giant roof hiding neighbor.
Between these functional institutions paint coherent small domestic village texture: a few tiny nonfunctional family cabins and granaries in gaps/back slope, firewood stores, low rough retaining walls, fence fragments, shared hearth, worn interconnecting paths, cleared doorway approaches, sparse windbent pines. They share one terrain and light, never cover another functional entrance. Low density but inhabited community, not empty rocky museum. Full architecture and all foundations uncropped; use full canvas, no frame, UI, text, labels, numbers, logos, borders, watermarks, people closeups or giant characters. Return ONLY one fully painted coherent scene.
